title: [Decision] demoStaff on hosted environments: a hosted demo organization has no platform door to get an app's declared demo accounts, so apps fall back to their own account scripts
body:
Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make (security boundary of who may mint sign-in accounts), filed on the maintainer's direct word, verbatim: 「demoStaff 的问题，立平台的决策卡」 (2026-11-13, Claude Code session `session_012dn2AfRg91ZPAKHATZmsTW`, PM seat for steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm). Reader: triage for routing (touches `plugin-auth`, `cli` compile and the hosted install path, so the cloud lane is a likely reader), then the director seat to present.
Dedupe: `is:issue demoStaff` (17 hits: #25777 origin, #26616 manager key, #26302/#26764 skills, #26424 prose — none on hosted environments); `is:issue demo accounts cloud environment` (35 hits; nearest is #30680, hosted sample-row ownership, ruled A — rows go to the installer — which this card does not reopen). **New.**

## 维护者速读

应用用 `demoStaff` 声明的演示账号只在本地 `os dev` 创建，`os build` 会把名单从部署包里删掉，部署环境也会拒绝创建，这是 hotclm#28 裁决 D 定下的安全边界。结果是托管的演示环境（比如给客户做汇报的 ObjectOS Cloud 演示组织）装好应用和示例数据后，一个演示账号都没有，种子里按名字分配给业务员的记录也找不到人。下游应用只能各自再写一个建账号脚本，这正是裁决 D 想消除的局面。本卡请你定：托管环境要不要、通过哪个入口拿到演示账号。我推荐 **C**：扩展现有的管理员批量导入用户接口，让它也能分配岗位和权限集；`demoStaff` 仍然只用于本地开发，部署包里不带演示名单，也不新增演示专用的能力。

## The question

An app declares its demo accounts in `demoStaff` (spec 18.2, `manager` since 18.3). They are provisioned only on a local development boot:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/demo-staff.ts` header: three gates — `NODE_ENV === 'development'`, a loopback auth base URL, `single` tenancy — plus "a database with no sign-in yet gets none".
- `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts:1237-1248`: `os build` deletes `demoStaff` from the artifact, so a deployment has no list to provision.
- Governing text: `packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts` — "The maintainer ruled the account creation the platform's (hotclm#28, letter D): 'demo accounts are the platform's to create; the app only declares them'" and "Development only — the security boundary … a password every developer of the application knows".

When a hosted demo environment (a demo organization on ObjectOS Cloud, never a customer's) needs the same people, what platform door gives them to it?

## Evidence of pull (measured)

steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm demos a carbon-black CRM to a client from a hosted demo environment. Its seed deals customers and orders to named reps, and the demo needs 9 accounts with positions, permission sets and direct managers (the two-level rating approval and the margin special approval route by position and by `manager`). Today it ships `scripts/demo-carbon.ts --remote` plus a manual workflow that creates the accounts through admin APIs: an app-side account script, the shape ruling D retired for local boots.

The existing admin door, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`), already creates sign-in accounts on any environment with the right credential policy (`invite`, or `temporary`: generated, shown once, `must_change_password`), and resolves a `manager_id` column by address. It does **not** assign positions or permission sets (no such columns), so the gap left to app scripts is exactly that.

## Options

| | Shape | Security boundary | Work |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | No change. Hosted demo environments use the existing admin doors by hand (import users, then assign positions and sets in Setup); apps document the steps, and app-side scripts stay as they are | unchanged | none (per demo reset: manual steps; downstream keeps its script) |
| B | Hosted opt-in demo provisioning: the artifact carries `demoStaff` (no password), and an organization admin on a hosted environment can trigger "create this app's demo accounts", credentials via the import-users policies (never the dev password) | widened: the artifact gains a list of accounts that can be minted in production; needs a revised ruling D and an install-time guard so a customer org never gets them | M–L (spec + compile + plugin-auth + hosted install UI) |
| C | Extend `import-users` with position and permission-set columns, resolved like `manager_id` (a second pass, through the same checks as Setup); `demoStaff` stays dev-only. A hosted demo is one CSV import, and real customers onboarding staff get the same door | unchanged (an admin-only door that already mints accounts gains two assignment columns, each through the existing assignment checks) | S–M (plugin-auth + spec of the import columns + docs/skills) |

## Four-dimension analysis

- **实际业务需求**：有实测拉动。下游项目每次给客户演示都要在托管环境里建 9 个带岗位和直属上级的账号，目前只能靠自写脚本。C 的入口不止服务演示：真实客户批量导入员工时同样要分配岗位，这是同一个需求。B 只服务演示。
- **项目长远合理性**（权重 ≥50%）：C 把"建账号 + 分配岗位"收进平台已有的管理员入口，`demoStaff` 的开发专用边界和"部署包不带演示名单"都不动。B 要在生产部署包里放一份能创建账号的名单，需要改写裁决 D，长期多一个必须一直守住的安全面。A 让每个应用继续自写脚本，和裁决 D 的方向相反。
- **防 AI 写错**：C 让 AI 只有一条路可走：本地用 `demoStaff`，托管环境用导入用户。B 会让 AI 误以为 `demoStaff` 在生产环境也生效，把演示名单写进客户应用。A 会继续诱导 AI 在应用里写账号脚本。
- **不扩散需求**：C 只给现有接口加两列。B 是新的演示专用能力面，按创业阶段的聚焦原则默认不做。A 什么都不加，但把成本留给了每个应用。

**Recommendation: C.** Fallback if the maintainer wants no widening now: A.

## Downstream state

steedos-labs/os-project-blackcat-crm#11 moves its local demo to `demoStaff` + `defineSeed` (spec-conformant) and keeps the hosted account step as a tracked interim, to be deleted once this card is ruled and executed.
